summary: Completed public API and responsive browser smoke testing for Mathura, Rewari, i18n, admin, SEO, and mobile navigation.

integration_issues.issue: The intro About link always routes to /about, which resolves to Mathura content instead of Rewari-specific /rewari/about when browsing Rewari.

action_items: Make the Rewari intro About link use /rewari/about, matching the location-aware hero CTA and nav.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has a location-context regression: Home's intro-about-link uses a hard-coded /about route; this loses Rewari context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API tests passed 4/4. Browser checks passed Mathura home/SEO, Rewari switch and about, Hindi toggle, admin route, and mobile menu. Re-test the Rewari homepage intro About link after fixing its hard-coded route.
rca of the issue: Home renders intro-about-link with to="/about" regardless of the location prop. Since resolveLocation maps /about to Mathura by default, clicking it from Rewari changes the content context to Mathura. Use the same conditional path logic as hero-explore-button.
